types.name: ToolpathKit
types.doc: Dependency-free toolpath format and geometry.

types.name: ClearanceStock
types.doc: A fixed stock envelope in machine coordinates, metres.

types.name: GearBinding
types.doc:
Resolve names and encoder counts from the model. Controller timing is deliberately explicit:
the driver position loop is a ceiling, not evidence of the owner's actual scheduling frequency.

types.name: GearEncoderTiming
types.doc: Extra encoder delay excludes delay already carried in the observation timestamp.

types.name: MachineBinding
types.doc: Machine axes and execution limits, independent of a G-code controller.

fields.name: auxiliaryJoints
fields.doc: Process spindle joint used to resolve per-work-revolution feeds.

fields.name: cornerAcceleration
fields.doc:
The acceleration the machine gives in the XY plane, metres per second squared: what bounds the speed of a rounded
corner (`CornerBlender.minimumRadius`). Zero until the motion binding sets it from the axes' limits.

fields.name: rapidsAtFeed
fields.doc:
Whether `Rapid`, `Link` and `Retract` moves run at their own feed (bounded by `rapidSpeed`) and round
their corners within their tolerance, as a printer's travels do, instead of at `rapidSpeed` with
exact stops, as a mill's rapids do.

fields.name: printer
fields.doc: The extruder and heaters, when the machine prints.

types.name: MachiningContinuation
types.doc:
A program that resumes machining partway along op `opIndex` of the
original, from `startDistance` along it: some approach ops, that op's
remainder at `resumeOp`, then the original's later ops.

fields.name: originalAt
fields.doc: The original op and distance along it for `op` and `distance` of this program; op -1 while approaching.

types.name: MachiningRecipe
types.doc: Restart settings for machining, independent of dispensing rates.

fields.name: clearanceZ
fields.doc:
Height in the motion frame that clears the work and its fixtures. With
it, a restart retracts there, moves across and descends to the restart
point; without it, it moves straight there.

types.name: MachiningRun
types.doc: Runs a machining program and prepares a safe mid-path continuation.

fields.name: prepareRestart
fields.doc: Aborts a held execution and returns the program to submit once idle.

fields.name: continuationFrom
fields.doc:
The program that resumes machining at `distance` along path op
`opIndex`, from where the machine stands: it loads the tool the program
had loaded there, restores the spindle and coolant, approaches (over
the recipe's clearance, when it has one) and carries on.

fields.name: spindleFault
fields.doc: Requests a controlled stop; call safeShutdown after the stop completes.

types.name: PrinterBinding
types.doc:
What lowering needs to know of a printer beyond its axes: the extruder joint and how it turns per metre of
filament, the hotend's melt-rate limit, and how the heaters and fans are reached. A bead of cross-section `area`
laid along a path takes `area / filamentArea` of filament per metre, and the extruder's gear turns
`1 / gearRadius` radians per metre of filament.

fields.name: extruderJoint
fields.doc: The robot-model joint of the filament drive gear.

fields.name: gearRadius
fields.doc: The effective radius at which the drive gear grips the filament, metres.

fields.name: maxFlow
fields.doc: The hotend's greatest volumetric flow, m^3/s: a bead is laid no faster than this melts.

fields.name: rampLength
fields.doc: How far along the path the extruder's rate ramps between runs of bead, metres.

fields.name: pressureAdvance
fields.doc: Pressure advance: the extruder runs `pressureAdvance` seconds ahead of the flow it feeds, seconds (0 is off).

fields.name: pressureAdvanceWindow
fields.doc: The window over which the extruder's velocity is averaged for the advance, seconds: it keeps the advance within the drive's limits.

fields.name: shapers
fields.doc: Input shapers by axis id (the axes of the machine binding): those axes' motion is shaped, everything else is delayed to match.

fields.name: extruderIndex
fields.doc: The extruder joint's index in the machine, set by the `ToolpathMotionBinding` that finds it.

fields.name: radiansPerMetre
fields.doc: Radians of the extruder gear per metre of path laying a bead of `area`.

fields.name: radians
fields.doc: Radians of the extruder gear for `length` metres of filament.

types.name: PrintingMotionBinding
types.doc:
One scene-job adapter for application execution and planning benchmarks.
Logical XYZ positions are machine metres; explicit joint offsets account for
the assembly's initial placement. Optional overrides describe benchmark variants.

fields.name: gcodeController
fields.doc: Fresh parser/writer state using the same filament as physical motion lowering.

types.name: PrintingMotionContext
types.doc: Assembly placement and execution context; initial positions are in authored assembly units.

types.name: RapidClearance
types.doc:
Reserves drive displacement around stock. Portions without this clearance are explicit exact-stop feed approaches.
Raw stock boxes are conservative: an already machined pocket is still treated as occupied. No geometry is displaced.

types.name: ToolpathChannels
types.doc: Controller channels scoped to one machine. A standalone machine uses an empty scope.

fields.name: heaterTarget
fields.doc: The analog channel a heater's target is set on, in degrees Celsius.

fields.name: heaterAtTemperature
fields.doc: The digital input that says a heater is within its band of a target above zero.

fields.name: fan
fields.doc: The analog channel a fan's duty (0 to 1) is set on.

types.name: ToolpathDiagnostic
types.doc: A lowering warning tied to its authored operation.

types.name: ToolpathLowering
types.doc: Converts plain CNC operations to MotionKit paths, barriers, and source map.

fields.name: stops
fields.doc: How many corners between moves the path stops at, by reason; tangent-continuous and rounded corners are not among them.

types.name: ToolpathMotion
types.doc:
Entry point for executing authored toolpaths on a bound machine. Moves are
lowered at the machine's controlled point: work origin plus G43 length.

types.name: ToolpathMotionBinding
types.doc: Binds pure CncKit programs to the physical joints of a direct XYZ machine.

fields.name: new
fields.doc:
`heldJoints` are joints the XYZ axes do not move and this binding does not plan (a printer's extruder
and the motor that turns it): they hold their position.

types.name: ToolpathPosePrimitive
types.doc: Keeps exact line, arc, helix, or fillet geometry for ProgramCompiler.

types.name: ToolpathSourceMap
types.doc: Maps MotionOp indices and path distance in metres to source locations.

types.name: ArcFitting
types.doc:
Replaces runs of short cutting lines that lie on one circle with arcs, so a
circle that CAM polygonized reaches the machine as G2/G3 again. A run
becomes an arc only if the arc stays within `tolerance` of the lines both
ways: every vertex lies on the circle and no chord strays from it by more,
so a genuine polygon is never rounded.

types.name: ArcPlane
types.doc: Arc planes in G-code coordinate order.

types.name: BeadSection
types.doc:
Rounded bead geometry shared by slicing, G-code and motion lowering.
Lengths are metres and areas m^2. These arithmetic helpers expect validated
positive inputs; a stadium's overall width is at least its height. Input
validation stays at each caller's settings/program boundary.

fields.name: area
fields.doc: Rectangle with semicircular sides, width measured edge to edge.

fields.name: spacing
fields.doc: Neighbouring beads at this spacing fill a layer of the given height.

fields.name: heightForArea
fields.doc: Reduce the nominal layer height when the supplied area only admits a circular bead.

types.name: GearTerm
types.doc: A master joint by stable machine name, rather than a mechanical transmission.

types.name: GeometryOffset
types.doc: Translates paths and offsets planar closed contours without CAM dependencies.

fields.name: profile
fields.doc: Round corners that open toward the cutter and trim the other joins.

types.name: GeometryTools
types.doc: Preview queries that do not require MotionKit.

fields.name: tangentAt
fields.doc: Unit tangent in the direction of travel at a distance along a path.

types.name: LayerVolume
types.doc: Material laid on one layer, in m^3.

types.name: MoveKind
types.doc: Intended role of a move along the path.

types.name: ObjectVolume
types.doc: Material laid for one printed object, in m^3.

types.name: PathGeometry
types.doc: Authored toolpath primitive. All coordinates and lengths are metres.

types.name: Point3
types.doc: Cartesian point in machine metres, independent of MotionKit.

types.name: PrintFeature
types.doc: What the moves that follow a `Feature` marker are for, as slicers label them.

fields.name: Other
fields.doc: Any other label; `name` is the slicer's own text.

types.name: PrinterOps
types.doc: Queries over the printing operations of `ToolpathOp`.

fields.name: isPrinter
fields.doc: Does this operation exist only for printing?

fields.name: provenance
fields.doc: The source of a printing operation.

fields.name: first
fields.doc: The first printing operation of `ops`, or null.

fields.name: validate
fields.doc: Throws if a printing operation is malformed. `index` names it in the message.

fields.name: coldExtrusion
fields.doc:
Where a program lays a bead or pushes filament before `heater` has been waited up to `minimumCelsius`, the
material's minimum extrusion temperature: a `Heat` that waits for at least that, with no later `Heat` below it,
is what makes extruding safe. The device faults a cold extrusion too; this finds it before the print starts.
Each finding is the source of the offending operation and says what it did.

types.name: Provenance
types.doc: Origin of a path operation. G-code locations are one-based.

types.name: ToolpathFrame
types.doc:
The coordinate state in effect at each operation of a program.

`Move` geometry holds programmed points: work coordinates of the active
setup, as G-code writes them. The machine's controlled point (the spindle
gauge line) is the programmed point plus the setup's work origin plus the
active G43 length in Z. The physical tool tip is that controlled point
less the loaded tool's own length, so a wrong H number shows up as a
shifted tip rather than being silently trusted.

Call `advance` with each operation in order, before using its geometry.

fields.name: toolNumber
fields.doc: The tool number in the spindle; -1 before the first tool change.

fields.name: toolLength
fields.doc: The active G43 length; zero after G49 or before any G43.

fields.name: toMachine
fields.doc: Translation from a programmed point to the machine's controlled point.

fields.name: tool
fields.doc: The tool in the spindle, resolved in the program's library.

fields.name: tipShift
fields.doc: Z translation from a programmed point to the physical tool tip.

fields.name: toTip
fields.doc: Translation from a programmed point to the tool tip in work coordinates.

types.name: ToolpathOp
types.doc: Controller-independent CNC operations in LinuxCNC block order.

fields.name: SetSetup
fields.doc: Selects a work-coordinate setup. IDs have no controller-specific meaning.

fields.name: Move
fields.doc:
Programmed points in the active setup's work coordinates, as G-code
writes them: with G43 active they name the tool tip, and the machine's
controlled point is the active length above. `ToolpathFrame` maps them.

fields.name: MachineMove
fields.doc: A move of the controlled point in absolute machine coordinates.

fields.name: PositionJoint
fields.doc: Absolute auxiliary joint position, SI units; independent planned coordinate when geared.

fields.name: WaitSignal
fields.doc: Digital barrier; the machine binding supplies the measured signal.

fields.name: FeedPerRevolution
fields.doc: Modal axial feed in metres/work revolution on Cut lines; distance=0 restores explicit feeds.

fields.name: ToolLengthOffset
fields.doc:
G43 Hn sets tool length offset `number` (G49 is number 0). Later `Move`
points are programmed at the tip, `length` below the controlled point.

fields.name: Deposit
fields.doc:
Modal: every following `Cut` move lays a bead of this cross-section until the next `Deposit` or
`DepositOff`. `area` is in m², and `width` by `height` is the bead's footprint, which its
rounded cross-section cannot exceed. `Rapid`, `Link` and `Retract` moves never deposit.

fields.name: DepositOff
fields.doc: Ends deposition: following `Cut` moves lay nothing.

fields.name: FilamentMove
fields.doc:
An extruder-only move, in metres of filament at `speed` metres of filament per second.
Positive primes, negative retracts. It is how retraction, unretraction and purge are written.

fields.name: Heat
fields.doc: Sets a heater, such as `hotend` or `bed`, to `celsius`; with `wait`, later moves wait until it is there.

fields.name: Fan
fields.doc: Sets a fan to a duty from 0 to 1.

fields.name: Layer
fields.doc: Marker: the layer `index` (from 0) printed at height `z`. Lowering ignores it.

fields.name: Feature
fields.doc: Marker: the moves up to the next marker are of this kind. Lowering ignores it.

fields.name: PrintObject
fields.doc: Marker: the part named `name` starts (or, with `start` false, ends). Lowering ignores it.

types.name: ToolpathProgram
types.doc: Controller-independent operations and the tools referenced by changes.

fields.name: depositedVolume
fields.doc:
The volume, in m^3, of the beads the program lays: each `Cut` move's length times the bead
area of the `Deposit` in force.

fields.name: layerVolumes
fields.doc: Deposited volume per layer, in the order the layers first appear. Beads before any `Layer` marker are layer -1.

fields.name: objectVolumes
fields.doc: Deposited volume per `PrintObject`, in the order the objects first appear. Beads outside any object are not listed.

types.name: Fixture
types.doc: A rectangular clamp or other forbidden volume in work coordinates, metres.

fields.name: new
fields.signature: (name:String, minX:Float, maxX:Float, minY:Float, maxY:Float, minZ:Float, maxZ:Float):Void

types.name: Setup
types.doc: Stock, clearance and clamp checks in the same work coordinates as CAM IR.

fields.name: workOrigin
fields.doc: Translation from work coordinates to machine coordinates, in metres.

fields.name: validate
fields.doc:
Rejects a program before export. The cutter clearance column and finite
shank/holder bands are swept at the physical tip, after the active G43 length.

types.name: SetupStock
types.doc: Optional stock and clamp geometry for validating a placed setup.

fields.name: spoilboardPlane
fields.doc: Top plane of the sacrificial spoilboard, coincident with the stock bottom.

fields.name: new
fields.signature: (minX:Float, maxX:Float, minY:Float, maxY:Float, top:Float, bottom:Float, safeZ:Float, ?fixtures:Array<Fixture>, ?spoilboardPlane:Float, ?breakthroughAllowance:Float):Void

types.name: TravelEnvelope
types.doc: Checks the controlled point in machine space: setup origin plus G43 length.

types.name: TravelViolation
types.doc: One toolpath point outside the configured machine travel bounds.

types.name: CutterProfile
types.doc:
A rotating tool as a surface of revolution about its axis. Segments run
from the tip (r = 0, z = 0) upwards and are continuous; the solid is closed
by the axis and by a flat top at the last segment's height. Heights never
decrease along the profile, so horizontal steps (a flat bottom, a shank or
holder shoulder) are allowed but overhangs are not. Units are metres.

fields.name: flat
fields.doc: Flat end mill; the flutes run `fluteLength` up from the tip.

fields.name: ball
fields.doc: Ball end mill: a hemispherical tip of the cutter's radius.

fields.name: bullNose
fields.doc: Bull-nose (corner radius) end mill.

fields.name: vee
fields.doc: V-bit with a sharp tip; `includedAngle` is the full cone angle in radians.

fields.name: taperedBall
fields.doc:
Tapered ball mill: a ball tip of `tipDiameter` blending tangentially into a
cone of `taperAngle` (half-angle from the axis) up to `diameter`.

fields.name: withShank
fields.doc: Appends a cylindrical non-cutting section, with a shoulder if the radius changes.

fields.name: cuttingDiameter
fields.doc: Widest diameter of the cutting zone.

fields.name: fluteLength
fields.doc: Height of the top of the cutting zone.

fields.name: below
fields.doc:
The part of the tool up to `height` above its tip, closed by a flat top
there: the tool as seen by stock whose surface is `height` above the tip.

fields.name: halfSectionArea
fields.doc: Area between the axis and the profile: half the tool's cross-section.

fields.name: volume
fields.doc: Volume of the solid tool.

fields.name: isRadiallyMonotonic
fields.doc: Radius never shrinks going up, so the tool's silhouette narrows only towards the tip.

fields.name: encode
fields.doc:
The profile as plain numbers, for JSON: one row per segment, `[0, zone,
r0, z0, r1, z1]` for a line and `[1, zone, centerR, centerZ, r0, z0, r1,
z1]` for an arc, with zone 0 cutting, 1 shank and 2 holder.

fields.name: decode
fields.doc: The profile `encode` wrote; rejects rows it could not have written.

types.name: CutterSegment
types.doc:
One piece of a tool half-profile. `r` is the distance from the tool axis and
`z` the height above the tip, both in metres.

fields.name: Arc
fields.signature: (centerR:Float, centerZ:Float, r0:Float, z0:Float, r1:Float, z1:Float, zone:CutterZone)
fields.doc: The minor circular arc from (r0, z0) to (r1, z1) about (centerR, centerZ).

types.name: CutterZone
types.doc: What happens when this part of a tool meets stock.

fields.name: Cutting
fields.doc: Flutes: overlap with stock removes material.

fields.name: Shank
fields.doc: Overlap with stock is a shank collision.

fields.name: Holder
fields.doc: Overlap with stock is a holder collision.

types.name: RouterBit
types.doc:
Router tooling dimensions in metres; the holder envelope includes the collet/nut.
Gauge length is spindle gauge plane to tip, independent of exposed cutting length.

fields.name: new
fields.signature: (number:Int, diameter:Float, cuttingLength:Float, stickOut:Float, gaugeLength:Float, flutes:Int, helix:String, collet:String, holder:String, holderDiameter:Float, holderLength:Float):Void

types.name: RouterCut
types.doc:
Explicit planning inputs: chip loads in mm/tooth; energy in J/mm3.
Values are assumptions until qualified for the actual bit/material lot.

fields.name: evaluate
fields.signature: (operation:String, bit:RouterBit, rpm:Float, chipMm:Float, minChipMm:Float, maxChipMm:Float, energyJPerMm3:Float, depthMm:Float, widthMm:Float, maxFeedMPerMinute:Float, maxRpm:Float):RouterCutResult

types.name: Tool
types.doc: Declared cutter dimensions in metres, with an optional exact shape.

fields.name: DEFAULT_FLUTE_LENGTH
fields.doc: Flute length assumed for a tool with neither a shape nor a length.

fields.name: fluteLength
fields.doc: Declared reach in metres; unknown values never qualify panel CAM.

fields.name: cutter
fields.doc: The tool's shape; null when only its diameter is known.

fields.name: shaped
fields.doc: A tool whose diameter comes from its shape.

fields.name: profile
fields.doc:
The shape to simulate. Without an explicit shape this is a flat end mill
of the declared diameter whose flutes run the whole tool length (or
`DEFAULT_FLUTE_LENGTH` when no length is known), so it removes material
but never reports shank or holder collisions.

fields.name: withLength
fields.doc: The same tool with a different stored length.

types.name: ToolLibrary
types.doc: Tools referenced by controller-independent tool changes.
